description: Metadata for public Inria pages on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and related research programs. Hosts are inria.fr and www.inria.fr. Rows are AI team, project, and news pages confirmed by one bounded GET. Login walls, shops, challenges, robots disallows, and off-host pages are omitted. Each row keeps a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text, abstracts, PDFs, quotes, transcripts, and chart data are omitted. Publisher is Inria. CC BY alone is creative_commons_attribution. CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix is creative_commons. A sole restricted deed keeps its own token. Mixed licences stay unknown. uk_ogl requires Open Government Licence. us_government_work requires a rights metadata field. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
